evidence: Rapid growth in artificial intelligence (AI) related data centers and other high intensity computing is materially increasing regional electricity demand and straining grids
advancements in AI pose serious risks for many of the traditional tools used to identify individuals, including voice recognition, facial recognition or screening questions
generative AI systems are increasingly used by malicious actors to create more sophisticated cyber-attacks and to circumvent controls, evade detection and even remove forensic evidence
These and other threat-related advancements expose us and Diamondback to increasing costs, including costs associated with additional personnel, protection technologies and policies
ai_positioning.summary: VNOM adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, identifiant principalement les risques liés à la demande énergétique des data centers IA et aux menaces cybersécurité amplifiées par les systèmes d'IA générative. Aucune initiative offensive ou intégration stratégique d'IA n'est mentionnée.
